jobs.description:
Company Description

About Us

VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together brands including CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, Golf Channel, Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, GolfPass, and SportsEngine.

StockStory, part of CNBC, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We operate like a startup—small team, high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—with the resources and long-term backing of a well-capitalized public company.

Our mission is to help individual investors make better investment decisions by combining institutional-quality equity research, quantitative methods, proprietary data, and AI.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Equity Research Analyst to lead the quantitative research behind our stock-selection models and help build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products.

You will be the primary quantitative research expert on a small, high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side talent, including senior analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with significant autonomy. You will cover investment research methodology, research prototypes, testing standards and model monitoring. Our engineering team will own production infrastructure and scalability, partnering with you to turn successful research into reliable systems.

You will operate as a research partner and lead the quantitative research behind High Quality Stocks, a long-only, factor-based stock-selection strategy designed around an approximately five-year ownership horizon. You will contribute to the development of both a quality framework and a valuation framework designed to identify high-quality businesses whose current prices offer attractive long-term return potential.

The quantitative model drives stock recommendations. Working closely with senior equity analysts, you will translate fundamental investment judgment into measurable hypotheses, systematic signals, ranking models, and decision rules. Analysts help shape and challenge the investment framework; you will own the methodology, empirical validation, and ongoing performance of our models.

What You’ll Do

Lead the quantitative research agenda behind High Quality Stocks.
Improve and refine a quality framework and valuation framework for identifying attractive long-term equity investments.
Partner with senior equity analysts to translate fundamental concepts and investment hypotheses into systematic signals and ranking models.
Design rigorous back tests using point-in-time data, with appropriate controls for look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting, multiple testing, and regime dependence.
Develop machine-learning models and frameworks to help improve performance of the strategy and discover new factors
Evaluate factor performance across sectors, company sizes, market environments, time periods, and portfolio-construction approaches.
Code research prototypes and apply statistical and machine-learning methods where they improve the quality or robustness of the investment process.
Partner with equity data analysts and AI/ML engineers to validate financial data and turn successful research into scalable, production-quality systems.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

Minimum of 5 years of quantitative equity research experience, ideally within a long-only asset manager, fundamental quantitative team, long-biased strategy, systematic equity firm, or similar institutional environment.
Direct experience researching long-only or long-biased equity strategies with medium- to long-term investment horizons.
End-to-end ownership of quantitative research, from hypothesis and data construction through back testing, implementation, and performance evaluation.
Strong fundamental equity knowledge, including financial statements, profitability, capital allocation, business quality, and valuation.
Strong knowledge of factor research, statistics, back testing, portfolio construction, and machine learning.
Strong Python skills and experience working with point-in-time fundamentals, estimates, market data, and other financial datasets.
Ability to independently own quantitative research while communicating findings clearly to fundamental investors, engineers, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience researching quality, value, profitability, or other fundamental equity factors.
Experience building stock-ranking models, screens, or model portfolios.
Experience applying machine learning to cross-sectional equity research.
Experience with LLM-powered research, financial-document analysis, or AI-assisted investment workflows.
Experience building quantitative research or models used by portfolio managers, equity analysts, or individual investors.

Location & Perks:

Hybrid 3 days in office
At CNBC Headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ, you’ll have access to great perks and amenities:
Sweat it out -- Free onsite fitness center with state-of-the-art equipment, plus daily group classes

Extras -- Dry cleaning, shoeshine, and sneak peeks
Don’t have a car? No problem! We offer free shuttle transportation to and from multiple locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Hoboken and Jersey City

In addition to these benefits, employees in this group will be joining at a time of meaningful and continued investment in data, technology, and product development, with the opportunity to contribute to a growing team within CNBC that is expected to scale significantly over time, offering meaningful exposure to senior leadership and the ability to influence how the platform evolves.

Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

Application architecture

Application security fundamentals

Experience as a:
Technical Product Owner, Technical Project Manager, or Engineering Project Manager

Experience in enterprise technology environments.
Experience managing multiple projects or products simultaneously.
Experience working with software engineering teams.
Technical certification such as PMP, Scrum Master, Product Owner, or similaris a plus.

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Sr. IT Project Manager – Shockwave Medica
l to join our team located in Santa Clara, CA.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Ready to join a team that’s pioneering the development and commercialization of Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) to treat complex calcified cardiovascular disease. Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Sr. IT Project Manager to lead strategic technology initiatives and drive execution across a diverse portfolio of business and IT projects. This role will partner closely with business stakeholders, functional leaders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership to successfully deliver complex, cross-functional technology programs.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing multiple concurrent projects, establishing effective governance processes, proactively managing risks and dependencies, and ensuring successful delivery from business case development through deployment and stabilization.

In addition to project execution, this role will play a key role in IT portfolio management, project prioritization, governance, and compliance initiatives.

Project & Program Leadership

Facilitate project governance meetings, steering committees, and executive reviews.
Provide clear and concise project status reporting to business and IT leadership.

Facilitate decision-making and proactively address roadblocks that impact project delivery.
Drive communication and organizational change efforts to support successful adoption.

Establish and enhance project governance frameworks, methodologies, standards, and reporting processes.
Lead IT monthly business review meetings to review different portfolios within IT.
Support project intake, prioritization, resource planning, and capacity management activities.

Risk Management & Delivery Excellence

Identify project risks, impacts, and dependencies early and develop effective mitigation strategies.
Monitor project health and proactively replan activities as business priorities evolve.
Conduct post-implementation reviews and lessons learned sessions.
Ensure adherence to project management best practices and delivery standards.

Compliance & Governance

Partner with Internal Audit, Quality, and Compliance teams for governance and compliance.
Support audit readiness activities and compliance remediation programs.
Ensure system implementation projects meet required governance, documentation, and validation standards.

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cross-functional IT projects and programs.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of both Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
Experience establishing or supporting PMO functions, portfolio management, and governance processes.
Demonstrate strong leadership and influence across both business and technical teams.
Experience leading enterprise application projects involving ERP (Oracle), or similar platforms.
Strong knowledge of software development and systems implementation life cycles (SDLC).
Experience in working with tools like Smartsheet, Jira, SharePoint, Visio, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft 365 Collaboration tools and Resource Management applications.
Experience working with audit, compliance, validation environments.
Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

new_jobs.description:
Description

The Technical Release Manager / Technical Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, governance, coordination, and execution of technical programs and production releases for the Omnichannel Engagement Platform (OEP). This role ensures engineering initiatives are thoroughly planned, coordinated, governed, and communicated from initiation through production deployment.

The position serves as the central point of coordination across engineering leadership, functional tower leads, operations, and external partners to drive alignment, manage dependencies, facilitate decision-making, and ensure successful execution.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional program and release management skills with strong technical acumen. While not expected to design or develop software, they must possess sufficient technical understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, validate implementation and testing strategies, identify gaps in technical plans, and proactively manage delivery risks before they impact execution.

Requirements

– 8+ years of technical program management, technical project management, or release management supporting enterprise software platforms.

– Experience leading complex software delivery programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, and cross-functional teams.

– Proven experience managing production releases and coordinating large-scale implementation activities.

– Strong understanding of Agile delivery, SDLC, Azure DevOps (ADO), release governance, and production implementation planning.

– Working knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and modern software engineering practices sufficient to effectively challenge assumptions and validate engineering plans.

– Experience preparing executive-level communications, dashboards, presentations, and delivery status updates for Director- and VP-level leadership.

– Demonstrated success managing risks, issues, dependencies, critical path activities, and executive escalations.

– Experience coordinating engineering leadership, functional tower leads, operations, and external delivery partners.

Job responsibilities

Program & Project Management

– Lead end-to-end planning, coordination, and governance of technical programs and production releases.

– Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, critical path activities, and delivery schedules.

– Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to ensure alignment with committed milestones and release objectives.

– Monitor overall program health and proactively address issues that may impact delivery.

Technical Planning & Release Management

– Partner with engineering leadership, functional tower leads, and external partners to translate technical solutions into executable implementation plans.

– Review implementation plans for completeness, sequencing, validation activities, dependencies, rollback procedures, operational readiness, and production support requirements.

– Consolidate implementation activities into Azure DevOps (ADO) work items, release documentation, implementation plans, release notes, and operational runbooks.

– Challenge technical plans when implementation details, validation activities, or dependencies are incomplete or introduce unnecessary delivery risk.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

– Proactively identify technical, operational, and program risks before they impact delivery.

– Manage cross-team dependencies and critical path activities across multiple concurrent initiatives.

– Drive mitigation planning, issue resolution, and executive escalation as appropriate.

– Provide leadership with clear recommendations, business impacts, and decision points rather than simply reporting status.

Executive Communication & Governance

– Prepare concise executive-level status reports, dashboards, presentations, and release readiness updates.

– Translate complex technical initiatives into clear business outcomes, delivery confidence, milestones, risks, and recommended actions.

– Present program health, implementation readiness, RAID items, delivery forecasts, and strategic recommendations to Directors, VPs, and senior leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

– Coordinate activities across engineering leadership, QA, DevOps, Requirements, Operations, and external partners.

– Build trusted relationships that promote accountability, transparency, collaboration, and timely decision-making.

– Influence without direct authority while driving alignment across multiple organizations and workstreams.

Partner & Vendor Management

– Coordinate delivery across multiple external engineering partners.

– Drive accountability for partner commitments, timelines, quality, and delivery execution.

– Facilitate issue resolution, resource coordination, and executive escalations when necessary.

– Foster a collaborative, one-team delivery culture across client and partner organizations.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) Commercial Solutions team ensures operational and programmatic excellence across deal cycles, increases revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drives closure of Stripe’s sold portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region. GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as User feedback and market insights. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Commercial Solutions team, responsible for developing, launching, and maintaining commercial constructs and programs to drive revenue for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Global Business Services' Commercial Solutions team is looking for a Commercial Solutions Program Manager to own the end-to-end programmatic development of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs that drive revenue for Stripe. Programs have a large scope and impact in nature, including owning the development and support of first-of-its-kind commercialization efforts, ongoing program support (pre- to post-launch), custom deal support related to the program, ownership of related enablement and communications, as well as acting as a change agent across the business.

You're responsible for the end-to-end management of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs, driving cross-organizational alignment through the delivery of related outputs. This role requires a background in program management and commercial program experience, change management, a strong understanding of private pricing frameworks (and pricing analysis), and experience scaling global, cross-organizational mechanisms.

You have experience in program management ownership, custom pricing strategies, and a background in supporting selling motions. You have strong communication skills and executive presence to effectively communicate with Stripe senior leadership. You'll love this role if you're a natural relationship and mechanism builder.

Responsibilities

Independently lead large scale, cross-functional commercial or GBS launch readiness programs that have Stripe-wide impact, oftentimes first-of-its-kind programs and initiatives
Manage and lead a highly complex program which requires considerable resources and high levels of complex functional and technical integration and knowledge
Support the commercial program deal motion, partnering with Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, sellers, and internal stakeholders to solution custom commercial approaches

Advocate on behalf of a position and quickly gain cross-functional alignment on the position
Quickly build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders
Provide strong leadership, communication, and persuasion skills
Lead projects to solve existing commercialization issues

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. You will coordinate complex programs spanning multiple engineering teams, product groups, legal stakeholders, and enterprise commitments.

A key focus will be driving cloud security initiatives, remediation programs, audit readiness, and secure operational practices.

The role combines strong program management with hands-on technical depth, including architecture reviews, production systems, security tooling, and incident analysis.

You will help establish scalable mechanisms for prioritization, intake, launch readiness, and long-term program execution.

The position requires the ability to reason deeply about distributed systems, cloud architecture, security data, and modern software development.

Working remotely from India, you will have significant influence on security programs supporting critical experiences at massive scale.

Lead and coordinate complex technical programs and multiple workstreams across Product Engineering, Security, Legal, and enterprise-facing initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Risk
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Stripe’s mission is to build the economic infrastructure for the internet. Risk and Compliance Engineering builds products to lower Stripe’s financial and regulatory risk at scale, while retaining a best in class user experience. We build user-facing products, and backend platforms to ensure Stripe’s users are compliant with regulatory and financial partner requirements. We protect Stripe’s brand while also protecting the company from financial losses that can put Stripe’s business at risk. The Risk TPM team is crucial to driving programs to address these challenges.

What you’ll do

As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you will play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. You will be responsible for the successful definition, cross-functional strategy, planning and execution of large-scale technical programs that help to solve complex problems and empower Stripe and our users.

Responsibilities

Execute on technical programs that require deep systems and engineering knowledge.
Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers and other cross functional partners to define, scope, and drive large programs to conclusion.
Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and KPIs to achieve goals with well defined success criteria.
Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.
Define and produce high quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.
Create widely circulated plans, driving consistency, clarity and building alignment across teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of software engineering, systems engineering and/or technical program management experience.
Excellent analytical skills; you digest complex information and make recommendations.
You have a track record of providing program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to launch, demonstrating critical thinking, challenging the norms and thought leadership.
You have very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams and senior leaders around the organization.
You can drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions and bring a wealth of experience, opinions, proposals and best practices.
Experience operating autonomously and leading large-scale efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in financial risk and compliance
SQL and python scripting and/or programming skills

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $157,700 - $236,500. Description

The Technical Release Manager / Technical Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, governance, coordination, and execution of technical programs and production releases for the Omnichannel Engagement Platform (OEP). This role ensures engineering initiatives are thoroughly planned, coordinated, governed, and communicated from initiation through production deployment.

The position serves as the central point of coordination across engineering leadership, functional tower leads, operations, and external partners to drive alignment, manage dependencies, facilitate decision-making, and ensure successful execution.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional program and release management skills with strong technical acumen. While not expected to design or develop software, they must possess sufficient technical understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, validate implementation and testing strategies, identify gaps in technical plans, and proactively manage delivery risks before they impact execution.

Requirements

– 8+ years of technical program management, technical project management, or release management supporting enterprise software platforms.

– Experience leading complex software delivery programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, and cross-functional teams.

– Proven experience managing production releases and coordinating large-scale implementation activities.

– Strong understanding of Agile delivery, SDLC, Azure DevOps (ADO), release governance, and production implementation planning.

– Working knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and modern software engineering practices sufficient to effectively challenge assumptions and validate engineering plans.

– Experience preparing executive-level communications, dashboards, presentations, and delivery status updates for Director- and VP-level leadership.

– Demonstrated success managing risks, issues, dependencies, critical path activities, and executive escalations.

– Experience coordinating engineering leadership, functional tower leads, operations, and external delivery partners.

Job responsibilities

Program & Project Management

– Lead end-to-end planning, coordination, and governance of technical programs and production releases.

– Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, critical path activities, and delivery schedules.

– Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to ensure alignment with committed milestones and release objectives.

– Monitor overall program health and proactively address issues that may impact delivery.

Technical Planning & Release Management

– Partner with engineering leadership, functional tower leads, and external partners to translate technical solutions into executable implementation plans.

– Review implementation plans for completeness, sequencing, validation activities, dependencies, rollback procedures, operational readiness, and production support requirements.

– Consolidate implementation activities into Azure DevOps (ADO) work items, release documentation, implementation plans, release notes, and operational runbooks.

– Challenge technical plans when implementation details, validation activities, or dependencies are incomplete or introduce unnecessary delivery risk.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

– Proactively identify technical, operational, and program risks before they impact delivery.

– Manage cross-team dependencies and critical path activities across multiple concurrent initiatives.

– Drive mitigation planning, issue resolution, and executive escalation as appropriate.

– Provide leadership with clear recommendations, business impacts, and decision points rather than simply reporting status.

Executive Communication & Governance

– Prepare concise executive-level status reports, dashboards, presentations, and release readiness updates.

– Translate complex technical initiatives into clear business outcomes, delivery confidence, milestones, risks, and recommended actions.

– Present program health, implementation readiness, RAID items, delivery forecasts, and strategic recommendations to Directors, VPs, and senior leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

– Coordinate activities across engineering leadership, QA, DevOps, Requirements, Operations, and external partners.

– Build trusted relationships that promote accountability, transparency, collaboration, and timely decision-making.

– Influence without direct authority while driving alignment across multiple organizations and workstreams.

Partner & Vendor Management

– Coordinate delivery across multiple external engineering partners.

– Drive accountability for partner commitments, timelines, quality, and delivery execution.

– Facilitate issue resolution, resource coordination, and executive escalations when necessary.

– Foster a collaborative, one-team delivery culture across client and partner organizations.

Continuous Improvement

– Identify opportunities to improve release governance, delivery planning, operational readiness, and execution maturity.

– Drive improvements to release documentation, implementation quality, and engineering delivery processes.

– Promote best practices that improve delivery predictability, operational excellence, and production stability.

The Senior Zero Trust Program Manager is responsible for end‑to‑end execution of Vanguard’s Zero Trust program, spanning Privileged Access, PKI & Certificate Modernization, Post‑Quantum Cryptography (PQC) readiness, and Zero Trust Assessments & policy‑as‑code enablement. This role acts as the central orchestrator across security engineering teams, architecture, risk/audit partners, and external vendors—ensuring outcomes are delivered against approved OKRs, investment commitments, and regulatory expectations, while providing clear, executive‑ready visibility into progress, risks, and decisions.

Core Responsibilities

Manage technology-related programs or major technical workstream of a broader program. Ensures that the scope of the projects within the broader transformation or program align with business priorities and that business value is properly measured for prioritization.
Develops and maintains broad knowledge and awareness of Financial Services industry forces, competition, and trends to assess viability of approaches and strategies to technology-related programs. Monitors financial, legal, and other regulatory environments to ensure strategies are aligned with the overall company strategy and market conditions.
Communicates with stakeholders, leaders, team members, management, and department partners to ensure that requirements and priorities are understood. Monitors project progress and results and submits regular status reports to management and internal and external stakeholders. Ensure all steps are taken to mitigate risk and maintains control, compliance, audit, and legal requirements on technology projects. Maintains an appropriate level of technical and business knowledge to support program implementation.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Zero Trust Program Leadership & Execution

Own the overall Zero Trust program plan, roadmap, and delivery cadence across all workstreams: Identity & Privileged Access (JIT / Standing Access Reduction) PKI modernization & certificate lifecycle automation PQC readiness and cryptographic agility Zero Trust assessments, maturity modeling, and future‑state design
Translate strategy into clear execution plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes aligned to enterprise OKRs.

OKRs, Metrics & Executive Reporting

Define, track, and report workstream‑level OKRs and KPIs in partnership with engineering and architecture leads (e.g., % privileged access delivered via JIT, certificate automation coverage, PQC readiness milestones).
Produce monthly, quarterly, and ad‑hoc executive updates for senior leadership (CISO, SLT, GR&S), emphasizing: Risk reduction Business enablement Delivery confidence Emerging dependencies or decisions required

Cross‑Functional & Vendor Coordination

Serve as the single coordination point across IAM Engineering, PKI, Cloud Security, Architecture, GRC, and Audit teams.
Manage delivery alignment with strategic partners and vendors supporting the Zero Trust program (e.g., assessment partners, PKI/PQC vendors, JIT platforms).
Ensure clear ownership models, RACI clarity, and handoffs between investment work and BAU operations.

PKI, Certificates & PQC Readiness Oversight

Execution oversight of PKI modernization initiatives
Track and drive PQC readiness activities, including cryptographic inventory, roadmap execution, and alignment with regulatory and industry guidance.

Zero Trust Assessment & Policy Enablement

Manage Zero Trust readiness assessments and maturity modeling activities.
Coordinate definition of target‑state personas, use cases, and policy‑as‑code approaches in collaboration with architecture and engineering teams.
Ensure assessment outcomes translate into prioritized execution plans, not shelfware.

Financial & Investment Governance

Partner with finance and PMO teams to: Track Zero Trust investment spend Support annual and multi‑year funding requests Align hiring plans (e.g., ZT Program Manager role, supporting engineers) with approved budgets
Identify risks related to hiring delays, vendor dependencies, or funding constraints and proactively surface options.

Risk, Audit & Compliance Alignment

Ensure Zero Trust initiatives are audit‑aware and defensible, particularly in areas such as: Privileged access controls (JIT) Certificate governance Cloud access consistency across platforms
Act as a liaison between delivery teams and GRC when Zero Trust topics are reviewed.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in program or portfolio management within cybersecurity, IAM, or enterprise technology.
Demonstrated experience running large, cross‑functional security programs with multiple technical workstreams.
Strong understanding of Zero Trust principles
Proven ability to communicate complex initiatives in clear, executive‑level language.
Experience working with external vendors and consulting partners.
Undergraduate degree in related field (Computer Science, Engineering) required. Graduate degree preferred.

The Security Operations Manager II
will oversee delivery of physical security services for QTS data center security operations, including oversight of contract guard operations, alarm investigations and incident reporting, and coordination with regional security disciplinary specialists on projects, expansions, and other security-related efforts. This role is responsible for providing a visual security presence to ensure visitors, clients, and employees have a safe and pleasant experience while providing excellent customer service to all individuals that enter the facility and further employee/management relations, goodwill, and public relations to keep our customers for life.

RESPONSIBILITIES, Other Duties May Be Assigned.

Supervise frontline security staff and daily security operations to provide a safe experience for all who enter the facility.
Manage security operations for a single or multi-building campus, or mega data center.
Participate in project estimating processes as well as contribute to others budgeting processes for physical security system needs in other groups. 
Oversee security projects to ensure they are delivered in accordance with established baseline requirements and deadlines and within budget. 
Maintain close coordination with security vendor management to ensure continuous improvement of security team skills through targeted training, practical exercises, and the documentation and application of lessons learned.
Interface with, and assist in, mobilizing vendors involved in system repairs for current sites.
Manage security for construction projects and new builds.
Develop and Implement security procedures and protocols to ensure the safety of employees, visitors, and assets.
Evaluate and drive continuous improvement of contract guard operations using key performance indicators, collaborative improvement plans, conducting training and leading security briefing for contractor and sub-contractor personnel to ensure great customer service in all Security interactions.
Ensure the Security Department is following all proper protocols, including monitoring the cameras, fire alarms, physical patrolling, recognition of items for proper written documentation of all security-related incidents, dispatching, and completing various logs/files daily.
Verify Data Center security programs are delivered to meet defined corporate security standards.
Assume 24/7/365 availability to respond to and manage appropriately all requests for emergency and non-emergency assistance in a professional manner.
Managing the process of bringing on new contract security staff for sites under construction
Ensure all security systems are fully functional to include Access Control, Visitor Management, Service Now, and CCTV.
Conduct Regular Risk Assessments to identify potential security vulnerabilities and develop strategies to mitigate risks.
Create, assign, and issue facility access badges to authorized personnel.
Investigate accidents, thefts, disturbances, and discrepancies and provide appropriate and timely notifications to required parties.
Knowledge and familiarization with all emergency response plans and evacuation procedures including conducting fire evacuation and Business Continuity drills.
Confirm all security equipment is kept in excellent working condition through regular inspection and by following QTS preventative maintenance programs.
Develop and maintain working relationships with Federal, State, and Local Law Enforcement as well as Fire and EMS services.
Generate reports and prepare presentations on the status of physical security operations and be able to deliver presentations and briefings to customers, stakeholders, and senior leaders.
Provides reports as needed for internal and external audits and investigations.
Serve as a customer advocate by identifying security-related opportunities and crafting innovative solutions that maintain uncompromising security standards.
Perform security officer duties as needed to ensure efficient operations and guest service standards are met.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years working in an operational, physical security. or equivalent environment.
5+ years of experience in security patrolling and reporting.
3+ years of experience in dealing with security vendors, contractors, and customers.
2+ years project management experience.
Bachelor's degree or five or more years working in an operations, physical security or equivalent environment or associate degree or three or more years’ experience working in an operational, physical security, or equivalent environment.
Must be able to travel up to 10% including the ability to travel to other sites to provide training and support as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of Security-related management and leadership experience
3+ years of experience in access control and video surveillance software applications (ex. ProWatch & Genetec)
3+ years of experience working in a facility and observing security gaps in physical barriers, security officer procedure, policies, surveillance equipment, and alarm points.
3+ years of experience driving campaigns to reduce nuisance alarms.
3+ years of experience influencing others in helping to achieve security excellence goals in a corporate environment.
3+ years of experience with excellent verbal and written communications skills in a professional work setting.
3+ years of overseeing security sub-contractors that provide guards, electronic security systems, door construction, door repair, fencing, and access controls.
2+ years of experience overseeing security construction projects.
2+ years of experience teaching others the proper security processes and methods.
Military Background or prior Law Enforcement experience desired.
Active Security Credentials (ASIS - Management Security, etc.).

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Proficient with computer skills including Microsoft Office suite.
Proficient in Access Control Systems and related software.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing; for the purpose of public interaction and report writing. Have excellent customer service skills.
Ability to handle typical emergency and crisis situations efficiently and effectively.
Ability to walk, stand, or sit for at least eight hours.
Position may involve frequent typing, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, bending, reaching, and lifting. Lifting requirements may range from 10 lbs. – 50 lbs. on a regular basis with heavier weights done in conjunction with other individuals or lifting aids.
May require 24x7x365 on call responsibilities.
This role requires on-site work hours to support a 24X7X365 data center environment and is not eligible for remote and/or hybrid work.

TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

This position is Bonus eligible.

new_jobs.title: Regional Security Manager, Mexico
new_jobs.description:
Position

Regional Security Manager, Mexico

Job Description

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.

A Fortune 148 company with 22,00 employees worldwide, Arrow brings technology solutions to a breadth of markets, including telecommunications, information systems, transportation, medical, industrial, and consumer electronics. Arrow provides specialized services and expertise across the entire product lifecycle. Arrow does this by connecting customers to the right technology at the right place, time, and price. Arrow provides extraordinary value to customers and suppliers - the best technology companies in the world - and connects them through the company's industry-leading services.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of Global Physical Security, the Regional Security Manager, Mexico
leads physical security operations, risk mitigation, vendor performance, and investigations across all Arrow locations in Mexico. Based onsite in Zapopan, Jalisco, this role builds strategic programs, manages contract guard forces and security tech, and leverages strong networks with local law enforcement and private security partners to protect employees, facilities, and business operations. Domestic travel and availability for off-hours crisis response are required.

What You’ll Be Doing

Security Operations & Program Management

Provide oversight and management of all contract guard services throughout Mexico.
Provide oversight and management of physical security projects throughout Mexico, including security system installations, upgrades, maintenance, and repairs.
Manage security integrators and vendors to ensure compliance with local laws, company standards, project timelines, and budget requirements.
Utilize intelligence and analytics to enable informed decision-making and enhance Arrow’s overall security environment.
Support the Director of Global Physical Security in investigations, security incidents, executive protection activities, and other security initiatives as required.
Support investigations and ensure proper evidence collection, handling, documentation, and case development when appropriate.
Partner with Human Resources, Legal, and business leaders on threat assessments and case management.
Promote awareness, education, and training programs designed to enhance employee safety and preparedness.

Law Enforcement and Private Sector Engagement

Serve as the primary liaison between Arrow Electronics and law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, private-sector security partners, and relevant industry security networks in Mexico.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with external security organizations and industry associations in Mexico.
Coordinate security-related communications and response activities during critical incidents and emergencies.

What We Are Looking For

Professional Experience

Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in corporate security, physical security, law enforcement, investigations, threat assessment, or a related security discipline, including at least 3 years managing security operations across multiple sites or regions, with demonstrated responsibility for protecting people, facilities, assets, and business operations.
Demonstrated experience managing physical security operations across multiple sites, including guard force oversight, incident response coordination, vendor management, security technology support, and site-level risk mitigation.

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

The Enterprise Customer Implementation Team at Gorgias works with our highest GMV merchants. Each implementation is truly custom based on the merchant’s business processes, procedures, and workflows. The team is successful when launches occur on time and merchants are promoters of Gorgias at the end of their implementation - excited to continue their customer journey with us.

understanding early what the merchant needs before they become a customer
migrating the merchant’s data to Gorgias
project managing custom builds and integrations to completion working cross-functionally with the technical solutions team
driving product adoption and AI Agent automation rate to 50%+ within 2 months of launch

Project manage cross-functional partners and workstreams to ensure successful go-live dates, such as custom builds (e.g., custom AI Agent actions, integrations)

QA AI Agent responses and iterate on prompts and guidance to tune performance over time
Analyze and interpret each merchant’s e-commerce and support data to shape their automation strategy and continuously optimize AI Agent performance post-launch

Act as the primary liaison between the customer and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and support throughout onboarding
Align executive stakeholders and build a mutual success plan to keep enterprise launches on track
Be an expert at Gorgias products and functionality always bringing a consultative approach

Experience: 3+ years with Implementations or similar experience within SaaS, with at least 3 years’ experience working directly with Enterprise clients, understanding enterprise merchants and the level of service needed. Have experience driving discovery in the sales cycle, doing technical implementations, and ensuring successful launches through project plans and organization.

You bring an assertive presence to drive timelines - proactively setting milestones, holding both internal and merchant stakeholders accountable, and keeping launches on track - while encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions.

Work Approach: Proficient in concurrently managing up to 20 accounts and projects. Adept at tailoring support to meet the diverse needs of both small and large merchants.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.
Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on mitigating churn and driving engagement and product adoption.
Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth.
AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI tools, discussing automation strategy with enterprise merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly.

🏖️ 5-week vacation (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws)

🤕 Paid sick leave

🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

💻 MacBook Air

🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions

The System Support and Student Records Sector, within the Program and System Supports Division of the Ministry of Education and Childcare provides school accreditation services, student records and system support, program administration, compliance verification, and policy guidance. The sector works collaboratively with school authorities and ministry partners to strengthen system capacity and support inclusive, responsive educational services for children and students across Alberta.

For more information on the Ministry of Education and Childcare, please visit https://www.alberta.ca/education-and-childcare

Role Responsibilities

Reporting to the Manager of Policy and Accreditation, the Research and Program Analyst provides a broad range of analytical and policy support to the sector, comprised of management, professional and administrative support staff. The analyst supports the development, evaluation, and implementation of departmental and cross-ministry policies, regulations, and procedures. The role includes research tasks, including jurisdictional scans and the collection and synthesis of information from internal and external sources, to support evidence-based decision-making, strategic planning, and accountability processes. The position also provides project management support by coordinating workflows, monitoring progress, and managing multiple timelines and priorities across branch initiatives.

The Research And Program Analyst Will Be Responsible For

Research and Analysis: Conducting research and environmental scans to identify emerging issues, trends, risks, and opportunities related to accreditation and education supports.
Policy and Program Development: Analyzing legislation, policies, procedures, data, and stakeholder feedback to support program planning, policy development, and operational decision-making.
Strategic Advice and Decision Support: Synthesizing information and providing evidence-based recommendations, options, and advice to support decision-makers.
Briefings and Communications: Preparing briefing notes, reports, correspondence, presentations, decision documents, and other materials for stakeholders and executive leadership.
Project Coordination Support: Providing project management support by planning activities, tracking progress, identifying and monitoring risks, and coordinating resources and deliverables.
Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration: Supporting consultation and engagement activities within the sector, with ministry partners, and other stakeholders by gathering input, summarizing feedback, and identifying key themes.
Issue Management: Monitoring emerging issues and responding to inquiries and information requests by providing timely, accurate, and professional advice.

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position.

Build Collaborative Environments: The Research and Program Analyst works collaboratively with internal teams, ministry partners, and other stakeholders to support shared objectives, resolve issues, and promote effective program delivery.
Develop Networks: This role builds and maintains respectful working relationships across the ministry and education system to exchange information, support consultation, and strengthen coordination on policy and accreditation matters.
Agility: The position adapts to changing priorities, emerging issues, and shifting timelines while maintaining accuracy, sound judgment, and a strong focus on deliverables and outcomes.
Develop Self and Others: The Analyst seeks opportunities to build knowledge, apply feedback, share information, and support a learning-focused environment that contributes to sector and ministry success.

1 year of education for 1 year of experience; or

Experience conducting research, analysis, and environmental scans to support policy, program, or operational decision-making.
Ability to interpret legislation, policies, procedures, data, and stakeholder input to identify issues, options, and recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare briefing notes, reports, correspondence, summaries, and decision materials for a variety of audiences.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate tasks, manage competing priorities, track deliverables, and meet timelines with accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to build effective working relationships and collaborate with internal teams, ministry partners, and other stakeholders.
Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and provide timely, professional responses to inquiries and information requests.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager Construction - Scaffolding
new_jobs.description:
Description

The InProduction team has spent the better part of the last decade combining the best seating and staging companies into a one-stop shop for most of what is needed to produce an event. Starting with SGA Production Services, we added and integrated T&B Equipment, CommuniLux Productions, Nussli U.S., and Seating Solutions to become today’s InProduction. These acquisitions have allowed InProduction to evolve into the largest provider of temporary seating, staging, structures, and scenic production for the United States events industry. Central are our people.

As an InProduction employee you are central to our sustained growth and success. We offer a rewarding career in a fast paced and exciting environment. Our employees demonstrate our core values in safety and quality every day while working to provide top notch service to our client partners. Whether working in the field, yard, warehouse, or office, InProduction offers a future with huge growth potential.

The Company is backed by ZMC. ZMC is a leading private equity firm comprised of experienced investors and executives who invest in, and manage, a diverse group of media and communications enterprises. Founded in 2001, ZMC’s investment philosophy centers on operational value creation driven by targeted investment themes, deep sector expertise, and strong partnerships with industry and operating executives. ZMC approaches its investments in collaboration with management teams and has a successful track record of actively adding value to portfolio companies.

Come join us! Check out our web page https://inproduction.net/welcome/

The Project Manager is responsible for managing project timelines and budgets while creating and implementing technical solutions and construction methods based on design concepts and visual information. The Project Manager must possess the ability to multi-task while maintaining attention to detail and must be highly organized. This position requires hands on experience related to Scheduling, Written and Verbal Communication, and/or general construction practices. The Project Manager must be willing to travel locally (40-50%) and out of market (15-20%) as required by project. This position reports to the Director of Operations & Vice President.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Onsite project management lead for all greater NY based jobs – approx 40-50% out of office in market.
Complete daily progress reports with crew attendance, photos & completion metrics for each day a job is active in the field.
Conduct site visits as needed for any greater NY area jobs.
Travel out of market as needed when nationwide project management bandwidth is limited during busier times – approx 15-20% out of market travel.
Per diem & travel expenses covered for all out of market travel to jobs/site visits.
Accompany clients, building dept, fire marshals etc on walkthroughs to inspect & confirm all installations are built to code & clients agreed to desires; acquire sign off on all projects prior to completion & exiting the job site.
Oversee project prep in Hauppauge WH prior to events – including but not limited to tools, hardware, materials & other misc equipment needs.
Assist with local project planning, schedules & logistics.
Ensure crews attend safety orientations, are up to date on all safety requirements & adhere to all safety regulations & have proper PPE while working.
Manage all job specific purchasing & procurement.
Assist WH manager with creation & verification of BOLs on inbound & outbound material.
Assist in development of project cost estimates in collaboration with the sales team.
Coordinate and review all technical drawings with the CAD Department & project foreman to ensure all details of job are captured prior to arriving onsite.
Coordinate and review detailed assembly/installation drawings with project foreman for use by the installation crew to ensure all details of job are captured prior to arriving onsite for load in.
Actively communicate with management & warehouse team to maintain shop production & logistics schedules in coordination with the project onsite.
Work closely with department heads and subcontractors to meet both budgetary and scheduling goals.
Communicate with the client, management & sales staff during the build & strike phases of the project to ensure all parties are aligned with progress, milestones & deadlines.
Manage changes to the project scope onsite & report any budgetary and/or staffing implications back to management.
Track and Report project costs compared to budget, assemble post mortem reports on all projects to give top-line view of how each project fared in comparison to estimates.

Requirements

Previous industry experience in scaffolding, construction, technical theater and/or scenic fabrication is a plus but not required.
Proficiency with MS Office & Teams.
High-level problem-solving skills.
Ability to make decisions when prioritizing the short- and long-term objectives for projects.
Must have outstanding relationship skills and have a team oriented, collaborative work ethic.
Ability to work within a flexible schedule.
Valid Drivers License.
Availability to report to Hauppauge office all workdays not scheduled to be present on jobsites.
Bilingual a major plus, but not required.

Education Qualifications

High School Diploma or Equivalent

Pay Scale

Salaried, Non-Exempt - $80-85K negotiable based on relevant experience.

Benefits

Health, Dental, Vision Insurance
Life Insurance
Vacation
Paid Holidays
Floating holiday
401 K Match

:

Define, develop and maintain both high level and detailed project plans, metrics and dashboards as well as any related budgets, including comprehensive ROI and risk assessment/mitigation plans.
Leverage your ability to lead without direct reports, be an independent subject matter expert, knowledgeable resource, facilitator, and coach to the Packaging & Labeling organization.

Utilizing lean sigma and standardized project management tools, oversee and manage project teams supporting project deliverables without direct reporting lines ensuring all functional requirements are met.

Gain alignment and acceptance for ideas, plans and actions and implement across organizational boundaries
Effectively Lead project team meetings to ensure clear agenda, effective actions and results
Successfully complete deliverables using standardized lean and PMP project tools and content management systems.

Independent thinker with demonstrated skills in identifying opportunities and translating ideas into actionable full-scale improvement projects, driving from initiation through to completion
Delivery of project milestones that support process / technology and other initiatives across the Packaging & Labeling organization that improve quality, cost, delivery and compliance leveraging experience in the Life Sciences industry
Facilitating the process for improvement projects, managing dashboards, metrics and communication process for product related projects and process/technology related initiatives.

Working across and up an organization as well as cross functionally, managing and assigning tasks to project resources to ensure high quality, on-time completion of project deliverables.
Deep experience in lean sigma and continuous improvement as well as expert project management and KPI skills.

Willingness to share your knowledge and learn new things
High level demonstrated communication skills both verbal and written.
Strong leadership presence. Ability to gain consensus and make decisions/recommendations.

BA/BS in Life Sciences, Packaging and/ or Labeling, Project Management or related field

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Credit Research Analyst – US Non-Bank Financials

About Us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Team Overview

Schroders manages over GBP75bn in global fixed income alpha strategies, with credit at the core of our approach. In addition, Schroders oversee around GBP200bn in solutions mandates, approximately half of which are allocated to fixed income and credit. Our Global Credit Research platform, which plays a key role in within the fixed income platform, is centralized in three key hubs—New York, London, and Singapore.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Credit Research Analyst to join our Global Fixed Income Research team in New York. The successful candidate will contribute differentiated credit insights focused on US non-bank Financials. The person will contribute to a team approach and will work extensively with portfolio managers, other analysts and support teams in NY and London and Asia.

Objective

To create forward-looking, non-consensus research that delivers alpha to Schroders’ fixed income portfolios.

Responsibilities

Perform fundamental analysis and financial modelling across covered names
Monitor performance and holdings relative to investment objectives, benchmarks and outlook
Provide opinions/reports on relative value analysis including buy/sell recommendations to the investment team and to the global credit research team
Provide ESG ratings for credits under coverage
Collaborate with other debt and equity analysts and portfolio managers as the credit expert on the covered industries
Frequently interact with portfolio managers and traders

Company Description

About Us

VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together brands including CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, Golf Channel, Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, GolfPass, and SportsEngine.

StockStory, part of CNBC, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We operate like a startup—small team, high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—with the resources and long-term backing of a well-capitalized public company.

Our mission is to help individual investors make better investment decisions by combining institutional-quality equity research, quantitative methods, proprietary data, and AI.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Equity Research Analyst to lead the quantitative research behind our stock-selection models and help build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products.

You will be the primary quantitative research expert on a small, high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side talent, including senior analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with significant autonomy. You will cover investment research methodology, research prototypes, testing standards and model monitoring. Our engineering team will own production infrastructure and scalability, partnering with you to turn successful research into reliable systems.

You will operate as a research partner and lead the quantitative research behind High Quality Stocks, a long-only, factor-based stock-selection strategy designed around an approximately five-year ownership horizon. You will contribute to the development of both a quality framework and a valuation framework designed to identify high-quality businesses whose current prices offer attractive long-term return potential.

The quantitative model drives stock recommendations. Working closely with senior equity analysts, you will translate fundamental investment judgment into measurable hypotheses, systematic signals, ranking models, and decision rules. Analysts help shape and challenge the investment framework; you will own the methodology, empirical validation, and ongoing performance of our models.

What You’ll Do

Lead the quantitative research agenda behind High Quality Stocks.
Improve and refine a quality framework and valuation framework for identifying attractive long-term equity investments.
Partner with senior equity analysts to translate fundamental concepts and investment hypotheses into systematic signals and ranking models.
Design rigorous back tests using point-in-time data, with appropriate controls for look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting, multiple testing, and regime dependence.
Develop machine-learning models and frameworks to help improve performance of the strategy and discover new factors
Evaluate factor performance across sectors, company sizes, market environments, time periods, and portfolio-construction approaches.
Code research prototypes and apply statistical and machine-learning methods where they improve the quality or robustness of the investment process.
Partner with equity data analysts and AI/ML engineers to validate financial data and turn successful research into scalable, production-quality systems.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

Minimum of 5 years of quantitative equity research experience, ideally within a long-only asset manager, fundamental quantitative team, long-biased strategy, systematic equity firm, or similar institutional environment.
Direct experience researching long-only or long-biased equity strategies with medium- to long-term investment horizons.
End-to-end ownership of quantitative research, from hypothesis and data construction through back testing, implementation, and performance evaluation.
Strong fundamental equity knowledge, including financial statements, profitability, capital allocation, business quality, and valuation.
Strong knowledge of factor research, statistics, back testing, portfolio construction, and machine learning.
Strong Python skills and experience working with point-in-time fundamentals, estimates, market data, and other financial datasets.
Ability to independently own quantitative research while communicating findings clearly to fundamental investors, engineers, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience researching quality, value, profitability, or other fundamental equity factors.
Experience building stock-ranking models, screens, or model portfolios.
Experience applying machine learning to cross-sectional equity research.
Experience with LLM-powered research, financial-document analysis, or AI-assisted investment workflows.
Experience building quantitative research or models used by portfolio managers, equity analysts, or individual investors.

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Sr. IT Project Manager – Shockwave Medica
l to join our team located in Santa Clara, CA.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Sr. IT Project Manager to lead strategic technology initiatives and drive execution across a diverse portfolio of business and IT projects. This role will partner closely with business stakeholders, functional leaders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership to successfully deliver complex, cross-functional technology programs.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing multiple concurrent projects, establishing effective governance processes, proactively managing risks and dependencies, and ensuring successful delivery from business case development through deployment and stabilization.

In addition to project execution, this role will play a key role in IT portfolio management, project prioritization, governance, and compliance initiatives.

Project & Program Leadership

Lead complex, enterprise-wide projects through all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.

Facilitate decision-making and proactively address roadblocks that impact project delivery.

Support project intake, prioritization, resource planning, and capacity management activities.

Risk Management & Delivery Excellence

Monitor project health and proactively replan activities as business priorities evolve.
Conduct post-implementation reviews and lessons learned sessions.
Ensure adherence to project management best practices and delivery standards.

Compliance & Governance

Partner with Internal Audit, Quality, and Compliance teams for governance and compliance.
Support audit readiness activities and compliance remediation programs.
Ensure system implementation projects meet required governance, documentation, and validation standards.

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cross-functional IT projects and programs.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of both Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
Experience establishing or supporting PMO functions, portfolio management, and governance processes.
Demonstrate strong leadership and influence across both business and technical teams.
Experience leading enterprise application projects involving ERP (Oracle), or similar platforms.
Strong knowledge of software development and systems implementation life cycles (SDLC).
Experience in working with tools like Smartsheet, Jira, SharePoint, Visio, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft 365 Collaboration tools and Resource Management applications.
Experience working with audit, compliance, validation environments.
Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

In the face of complex technical and operational challenges with no established playbooks to follow, we act with thoughtful urgency, driving conversations, discussions, and outcomes. Technical Judgment: Exercise strong technical judgment to contribute to tool/platform design discussions, evaluate architectural trade offs, and ensure deliverable quality
Operations & Release Coordination: Coordinate releases, manage tool deployment, and oversee triage workflows for simulation platforms to ensure high reliability and usability for developer teams
Process Scaling: Identify systemic bottlenecks in the offline evaluation loop and implement process or tooling improvements to scale simulation capabilities and efficiency

You Have

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
TPM Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in a software engineering or large scale infrastructure environment
ML Experience: 2+ years of experience managing technical projects involving machine learning infrastructure, model training/evaluation loops, or ML data pipelines
Program Ownership: Proven track record of owning and driving complex technical programs end-to-end, managing timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders
Technical Judgment: Strong technical judgment with the ability to engage in design discussions with engineering leads and analyze technical trade offs
Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both research and infrastructure teams

We Prefer

MLOps & Tooling: Experience with ML frameworks (JAX, PyTorch) and cloud based ML training/evaluation platforms
ML Based Simulation: Familiarity with advanced simulation technologies, including ML based scene generation (e.g. NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, Diffusion, etc.) and reactive agent modeling
Simulation: Familiarity with autonomous system simulation, log playback infrastructure, or closed-loop model validation strategies
Data Management: Experience with large scale dataset management, data validation frameworks, or unified data solutions
Developer Platforms: Experience building or managing developer tools or platforms that simplify complex developer workflows
